knowledge:
- key_parameters: thresh=Threshold for gene-set overlap in computeMsigOverlap (default Jaccard index, e.g., 0.25) ;; genesetStat=Named numeric vector of gene-set statistics (e.g., p-values or FDR) passed to plotMsigNetwork or findMsigClusters to project statistics or order clusters ;; alg=Graph clustering algorithm function (e.g., igraph::cluster_walktrap) passed to findMsigClusters ;; minSize=Minimum size of clusters to retain in findMsigClusters ;; rmUnmarkedGroups=Logical in plotMsigNetwork to remove nodes not belonging to marked groups for focused visualization ;; type=Type of text-mining source in plotMsigWordcloud, either 'Name' (gene-set names) or 'Short' (short descriptions) ;; geneStat=Named numeric vector of gene-level statistics (e.g., logFC) passed to plotMsigPPI ;; threshStatistic=Threshold for filtering PPI networks based on gene statistics in plotMsigPPI ;; threshConfidence=Threshold for filtering PPI networks based on interaction confidence in plotMsigPPI
- alternatives: igraph::cluster_walktrap is recommended for dense graphs, but other igraph community detection algorithms can be used in findMsigClusters ;; Overlap coefficient can be used instead of the default Jaccard index in computeMsigOverlap to highlight hierarchical overlaps (such as in Gene Ontology)
- when_to_use: Use when a gene set enrichment analysis (e.g., from limma::fry, singscore, or GSEA) yields a long, overwhelming list of significant gene sets that need to be summarized into high-level biological themes.
- pitfalls: Using too low of an overlap threshold (thresh) in computeMsigOverlap might result in an overly dense network that is hard to cluster or interpret ;; Failing to set a seed (set.seed) before plotting networks or PPIs, leading to non-reproducible layouts ;; Not matching the names of the gene-set statistics vector (geneset_stats) or gene-level statistics vector (gene_stats) to the exact names/IDs used in the GeneSetCollection

workflows.name: summarize_gsea_results
workflows.intent: Summarize and interpret a list of significant gene sets from an enrichment analysis using network clustering, text-mining, and gene/PPI visualization.
input: geneset_gsc (A GeneSetCollection object containing the significant gene sets from GSEA)
geneset_stats (A named numeric vector of gene-set level statistics, e.g., FDR or enrichment scores)
gene_stats (A named numeric vector of gene-level statistics, e.g., logFC from differential expression)
ppi (A protein-protein interaction database object, e.g., from msigdb::getIMEX)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute gene-set overlap using computeMsigOverlap ;; 2. Build the overlap network using computeMsigNetwork ;; 3. Identify clusters of gene-sets using findMsigClusters ;; 4. Characterize clusters using text-mining with plotMsigWordcloud ;; 5. Visualize gene-level statistics for clusters using plotGeneStats ;; 6. Visualize protein-protein interactions in clusters using plotMsigPPI ;; 7. Combine visualizations using patchwork
workflows.code:
#compute gene-set overlap
gs_ovlap = computeMsigOverlap(geneset_gsc, thresh = 0.25)
#create an overlap network
gs_ovnet = computeMsigNetwork(gs_ovlap, msigdb_hs)
#plot the network
set.seed(36) #set seed for reproducible layout
plotMsigNetwork(gs_ovnet)

#plot the network and overlay gene-set statistics
set.seed(36) #set seed for reproducible layout
plotMsigNetwork(gs_ovnet, genesetStat = geneset_stats)

#identify clusters - order based on cluster size and avg gene-set stats
grps = findMsigClusters(gs_ovnet,
                        genesetStat = geneset_stats,
                        alg = cluster_walktrap,
                        minSize = 5)
#plot the top 12 clusters
set.seed(36) #set seed for reproducible layout
plotMsigNetwork(gs_ovnet, markGroups = grps[1:6], genesetStat = geneset_stats)

set.seed(36) #set seed for reproducible layout
plotMsigNetwork(
  gs_ovnet,
  markGroups = grps[1:6],
  genesetStat = geneset_stats,
  rmUnmarkedGroups = TRUE
)

#compute and plot the results of text-mining
#using gene-set Names
plotMsigWordcloud(msigdb_hs, grps[1:6], type = 'Name')
#using gene-set Short descriptions
plotMsigWordcloud(msigdb_hs, grps[1:6], type = 'Short')

#plot the gene-level statistics
plotGeneStats(gene_stats, msigdb_hs, grps[1:6]) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = 2, lty = 2)

#create the PPI plot
set.seed(36)
plotMsigPPI(
  ppi,
  msigdb_hs,
  grps[1:6],
  geneStat = gene_stats,
  threshStatistic = 0.2,
  threshConfidence = 0.2
)

#create independent plots
set.seed(36) #set seed for reproducible layout
p1 = plotMsigWordcloud(msigdb_hs, grps[1:6], type = 'Name')
p2 = plotMsigNetwork(gs_ovnet, markGroups = grps[1:6], genesetStat = geneset_stats)
p3 = plotGeneStats(gene_stats, msigdb_hs, grps[1:6]) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = 2, lty = 2)
p4 = plotMsigPPI(
  ppi,
  msigdb_hs,
  grps[1:6],
  geneStat = gene_stats,
  threshStatistic = 0.2,
  threshConfidence = 0.2
)

#combine using functions from ggpubr
p1 + p2 + p3 + p4 + plot_layout(2, 2)
